Context: (vii) Timing restrictions.-

- GIO (4) (b), SR 51.  
4. No D.A. for Sundays and Holidays unless the employee is actually and not merely constructively on camp. No D.A. for leave and restricted holidays availed while on tour.. - GIO (1), SR 72.
5. Full D.A. is admissible for the first 180 days of continuous halt at a station on tour I temporary transfer I training. No D.A. beyond 180 days. - GIO (1), SR 73.
